newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa mixed after light day's trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa mixed after light day's trading.

text.p: Cocoa ended narrowly mixed after a day's light trading.
Front month March was most active. It last traded 4 stg down at 846 stg. May last traded 2 stg down at 874 stg.
Total volume was 5,721 lots of which 1,649 were on March and 1,336 on May.
"It's very much content to sit in its established range," one trader said. "There's not much volume either way."
There had been the odd push, he said. And there would be industry buying into dips. But origin sellers were largely staying away.
"I don't get the impression there's much in the way of origin sales," he said.
There were some speculative shorts, but they were not in a hurry to act, he added.
